title: Rickover tells Townsend Brown the Navy already figured it out

tellings.quote: Tonsen Brown goes to Hyman Rick Rickover who is the head of the nuclear navy basically started the American nuclear navy and himman And Rick over says, "Uh, towns and you know, stop wasting your time. Like we've already figured this stuff out back then."

plain: The inventor Thomas Townsend Brown is said to have gone to Hyman Rickover, the admiral who founded and ran the American nuclear navy, and been told to stop wasting his time because the Navy had "already figured this stuff out back then." Michels tells it himself, naming the researcher Paul LaViolette among his sources. If true, it would mean the Navy had quietly solved the kind of advanced propulsion Brown was working on.
